content: coder/coder reconnectingpty (source-verified v2.36.0): interface Attach(connID,conn,h,w) pipes conn+pty, replays history, blocks; states Starting->Ready->Closing->Done forward-only; Timeout option kills PTY after N without connections (heartbeat resets); TWO backends: screen (delegates to GNU screen if installed) and buffered fallback explicitly called BUGGY in docs; buffered backend: armon/circbuf 64KiB ring, single reader goroutine writes ring THEN fans out to all activeConns under one mutex (TODO comment admits channel-per-conn would be better - head-of-line blocking: one slow conn.Write stalls everyone); attach = clone ring bytes + write to conn + add to map; resize on attach to attacher's dims; process exit detected via PTY read EOF not wait().
